Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.model.liquidity

Class KfeChannelOperationDecisionEntity

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.model.liquidity.KfeChannelOperationDecisionEntity
@Entity public class KfeChannelOperationDecisionEntity extends Object
Stores the result and execution context of a channel open or close policy decision.

The decision snapshot includes the evaluated flags, rationale, idempotency key, and provider references needed to safely continue an operation across retries. Mesh intent and funding fields track the staged mesh-to-LND open flow; they are optional for decisions that do not use that integration. A passed decision records policy approval, while executed records whether the approved action was actually carried out.
